title: Calcutta High Court Holds Urgent Sunday Sitting To Hear Plea By Abhishek Banerjee-Linked Company Against Demolition Of His TMC Party Office
description: The Calcutta High Court is set to hear an urgent writ petition filed by Leaps and Bounds challenging the demolition of its immovable property at Amtala, housing TMC MP Abhishek Banerjee's party office, alleging that the action undertaken by the authorities was "gross, malicious and illegal." The matter has been specially listed today before Justice Raja Basu Chowdhury after being assigned by the Acting Chief Justice on Sunday morning.
